scene bedroom_day
$ totaldays += 1
: She knows.
lines.zh: : 她知道了。

lines.en: And it’s because she knows that I must make her forget — a task easier said than done when such powers exist within the hands of God but not my own, despite how godly they may be.
lines.zh: 而正因为她知道了，我才必须让她忘记——这话说着容易做着难，毕竟这样的能力只在上帝手中，而不在我手里，尽管它们也许神圣得可以。

lines.en: She will be here soon. I can sense it. That foreboding guilt and the mind-numbing sensation of waiting in the confessional after murdering the priest.
lines.zh: 她很快就会来。我能感觉到。那种不祥的负罪感，那种谋杀了神父之后等在告解室里的、让思维麻木的感觉。

lines.en: Bathed in silence and blood, I assign myself penance while delegating blame to those who helped mold me into the disfigured creature I am today.
lines.zh: 沐浴在寂静与鲜血里，我为自己定下苦行，同时把罪责推给那些把我塑造成今天这副畸形模样的人。

lines.en: I take the Apostles’ Creed and whisper a Hail Mary for each of Our Fathers, hoping the influx of unsanctioned divinity will coat me in a silky-smooth membrane that makes me invisible from above.
lines.zh: 我念起《使徒信经》，为每一遍《天主经》低声念一段《圣母经》，盼着这股未经许可的神性涌入、给我裹上一层丝滑的薄膜，好让天上看不见我。

lines.en: It’s the same way I felt in corners in the past in a room that I’ve forgotten but haven’t. And the same thing I hope you feel when you feel the way I feel.
lines.zh: 这和我从前在某个房间里、在某个角落里的感觉一样——那个房间我忘了，又没有忘。也是我希望你在我这种感受时所感受到的东西。

lines.en: Yet, I feel it’s not enough. And that years if not decades if not centuries of learning that the pen is mightier than the sword mean nothing when I scribe my sins in blood.
lines.zh: 然而，我觉得这还不够。而那些年——若不是几十年、若不是几百年——学到「笔锋胜于剑锋」，在我用血写下自己的罪时，什么意义也没有。

lines.en: But can you read the language I speak? This one I made up. This one where nothing means anything until it happens to you. And then, even when it does, all you see are pretty letters.
lines.zh: 可你读得懂我说的这门语言吗？这门我自己编出来的语言。在这门语言里，万事万物都没有意义，直到它发生在你身上。而就算发生了，你眼中所见也不过是些漂亮的字母。

lines.en: Red dresses to match each sentence, or her eyes, or the color of the sky when the reckoning rolls in and you are forced to confront not your demons but mine.
lines.zh: 红裙子，好配得上每一个句子，或者她的眼睛，或者当清算滚滚而来、你被迫面对的不是你自己的心魔而是我的时候，天空的颜色。

lines.en: I have brought them here and chained them to pillars of salt. Commanded they consume the corpses I leave at their feet like a cat killing mice for its master.
lines.zh: 我把它们带到这里，锁在盐柱上。命令它们吞食我丢在它们脚边的尸体，像猫替主人咬死老鼠那样。

lines.en: Alas, I stand here now having not killed one myself, but having scavenged it from a breeding ground. Exactly where it was meant to be. Exactly where the defenses were a little bit thin.
lines.zh: 唉，如今我站在这里，没有亲手杀死任何一个，却是从某个滋生地里捡来的。恰好在它该在的地方。恰好在防备略微单薄的地方。

lines.en: And all I needed to do was look like I belong while donning a pair of pointy ears.
lines.zh: 而我只需要戴上一对尖耳朵，装出一副「我属于这里」的样子就够了。

lines.en: She knows. She knows what I have done.
lines.zh: 她知道。她知道我做了什么。

lines.en: Yet, remorse does not find me and panic does. Shame. Guilt.
lines.zh: 然而，找上我的不是懊悔，而是恐慌。羞耻。内疚。

lines.en: And the incessant desire to drag her into the pit I dug so she can see how much greener the grass can be when all other colors are butchered like lambs.
lines.zh: 还有那无休止的欲望——想把她也拖进我挖的坑里，好让她看看，当所有别的颜色都像羔羊一样被宰尽时，那边的草能有多绿。

lines.en: The bell rings. I sigh. I know my time has come. How the gallows wait impatiently to watch words like “hang” become “hung.”
lines.zh: 门铃响了。我叹了口气。我知道我的时刻到了。绞架等得多不耐烦啊，就等着看「hang」这样的词变成「hung」。

lines.en: But in the transition from present to past, where people die but their actions last, perpetuated by others in this collection we’ve amassed, I must ask.
lines.zh: 但在从现在时到过去时的转换中——人会死，行为却留下来，被别人在我们积攒下的这堆收藏里延续下去——我必须问一句。

lines.en: If you were me, and you knew you were wrong, and someone else knew you were wrong, would you tell them you are wrong? Or would you ask why they asked at all?
lines.zh: 如果你是我，你知道自己错了，而别人也知道你错了——你会告诉他们你错了吗？还是你会问，他们为什么要问？

lines.en: scene black
I slip deeper down the well.
lines.zh: 我沿着井壁往下滑得更深。

lines.en: How much further can I fall?
lines.zh: 我还能再往下坠多远？

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation1
: Uhh...hey.
: Hi. I assume you already know why I’m here. But I brought Sara along for moral support since I felt weird doing this on my own. I hope you don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我想你已经知道我为什么来了。不过我把 Sara 也带来了，给我壮壮胆——一个人来总觉得怪怪的。希望你不介意。

lines.en: : Is Ami home? I figured I can just hang out with her while you guys talk.
lines.zh: : Ami 在家吗？我想你们聊的时候，我可以跟她待着。

lines.en: : I think she’s getting ready to go to the mall, but yeah. She’s here. I can’t imagine how much “moral support” you’ll be able to provide from her room, though.
lines.zh: : 她好像正准备出门去商场，不过在的，她在家。可我想不出你在她房间里能提供多少「精神支持」。

lines.en: : It was bringing myself to actually, well...bring myself here that was difficult. I can handle the rest on my own, I think.
lines.zh: : 难的其实是……把自己弄到这儿来。剩下的我想我自己能应付。

lines.en: : Okay...I don’t have a DVD player, though.
lines.zh: : 好吧……不过我没有 DVD 机。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation2
: Oh, good. Then maybe I can actually get through this without colossally fucking up and making my daughter hate me even more than she already does.
lines.zh: : 哦，那好。那说不定我今天真能好好把话说完，不至于一塌糊涂地搞砸、让我女儿更恨我。

lines.en: : Kids say a lot of things, Maki. Makoto doesn’t hate you. She’s just a little upset that you...did that really weird thing that you did. I’m sure she’ll get over it soon.
lines.zh: : 小孩子什么话都说得出口，Maki。Makoto 不恨你。她只是有点生气——因为你……做了那件特别怪的事。我相信她很快就会过去的。

lines.en: : Which is right when I’m sure I’ll find another way to ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 而她刚好过去的那个时候，我肯定又会找到别的办法把一切搞砸。

lines.en: : Well, uhh...come in, I guess?
lines.zh: : 那，呃……进来吧？

lines.en: scene black
: Do you guys want, like...coffee or something? Ami got me a book for Christmas about a bunch of different ways to brew it and some sort of wave machine thing.
lines.zh: : 你们要不要……咖啡什么的？Ami 圣诞节送了我一本书，讲各种冲咖啡的方法，还有个什么波浪机器。

lines.en: : What’s “Christmas?” Some kind of religious holiday?
lines.zh: : 「圣诞节」是什么？某种宗教节日？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...yeah. Let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……对。就这么理解吧。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation3
: Sara! What are you doing here? Are we going camping again?
lines.zh: : Sara！你怎么在这儿？我们又要去露营了吗？

lines.en: : Maybe next time, okay? We can still hang out for a little while, though! I’m just moral support today.
lines.zh: : 下次吧，好吗？不过我们还是能玩一会儿的！我今天就是来当精神支持的。

lines.en: : I’m also here. You can say hi to me too.
lines.zh: : 我也在啊。你也可以跟我打招呼。

lines.en: : Oh, I know. I just don’t like you.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。我就是不喜欢你。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation4
: Your daughter’s a real bitch, Akira. Maybe you can give me some advice on how to deal with that?
lines.zh: : 你女儿真是个婊子，Akira。也许你能给我点怎么处理这种事的建议？

lines.en: : Ami, that wasn’t very nice. Apologize to Maki.
lines.zh: : Ami，这样说不太好。跟 Maki 道歉。

lines.en: : No.
scene makiconfrontation5
: I’m sorry. I’ve done all I can do. Anything else will be overstepping unless Akira marries me and I become Ami’s new mom.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我能做的都做了。再多管就是越界了——除非 Akira 娶了我、我成了 Ami 的新妈妈。

lines.en: : Ami, go to your room. And take Sara with you.
lines.zh: : Ami，回你房间去。把 Sara 也带上。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Okay. But if the lube dealer lady tries selling you stuff, tell her that you don’t want any because you already have a perfectly good and very reusable toy at home!
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过要是那个卖润滑液的大婶想向你推销东西，就告诉她你什么都不想要——因为你家里已经有一个又好、又能反复使用的玩具了！

lines.en: else:
: Okay. But if the lube dealer lady tries selling you stuff, remember that you already have a perfectly good and reusable toy at home! You just haven’t ever touched it yet!
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过要是那个卖润滑液的大婶想向你推销东西，记住你家里已经有一个又好、又能反复使用的玩具了！只是你还没碰过它而已！

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation6
: Do you really? That’s actually super surprising. I thought most guys just used their hand.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这可真够让人意外的。我还以为大多数男人都只用手呢。

lines.en: : Did you get it from me? Please tell me it’s not from Amazon. Don’t buy sex toys from Amazon. Shop local, cum local. That’s Bukkake Maki’s slogan.
lines.zh: : 你是在我这儿买的吗？别告诉我是从 Amazon 买的。别在 Amazon 买情趣玩具。支持本地，射在本地。这是「颜射 Maki」的口号。

lines.en: : Yay! I’m finally part of an adult conversation.
lines.zh: : 耶！我终于也能参与大人的谈话了。

lines.en: : Ami. Room. Now.
lines.zh: : Ami。回房间。现在。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation7
: Fiiiiine...Come on, Aunt Sara! You can help me get ready to meet up with my friends.
lines.zh: : 好——吧……走吧，Sara 阿姨！你可以帮我收拾一下，好去见我的朋友们。

lines.en: : Hah...Sorry about that. She can be...unpredictable sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哈……抱歉啊。她有时候……挺捉摸不定的。

lines.en: : Still more effective than me. I’m not sure if I’ve ever successfully gotten Makoto to go to her room before.
lines.zh: : 但还是比我管用。我不确定自己有没有成功让 Makoto 回过房间。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation8
: Should we sit? So I can talk more about my failures as both a parent and a friend and you can talk about yours as a teacher and authority figure?
lines.zh: : 我们坐下吧？这样我就能继续讲讲我作为家长、作为朋友有多失败，你也可以讲讲你作为老师和权威人物有多失败。

lines.en: : You’re calmer than I expected you to be.
lines.zh: : 你比我预想的要平静。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, I feel like I kind of have to be when everyone has spent the past month gaslighting me into thinking I’m overreacting here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，没办法——这一个月来所有人都在对我搞煤气灯那一套，让我觉得是我在反应过度，我不得不平静点。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation9
: But let me ask you, Akira. Do you think I’m overreacting? Or do you, as a parent, understand where I’m coming from?
lines.zh: : 不过我想问你，Akira。你觉得我是反应过度吗？还是说，你作为一个家长，能理解我的出发点？

lines.en: : Because Ami’s a cute girl. Evil, but cute. And I’m sure you’d be extremely protective of her if you started to pick up on signs that she was sleeping with one of your older friends.
lines.zh: : 因为 Ami 是个可爱的女孩。坏，但是可爱。我相信，一旦你看出她在和你某个年纪更大的朋友上床的迹象，你一定会拼命护着她。

lines.en: : You’re not overreacting at all. You’re right to be worried. It would have been nice not being blindsided by porn, though.
lines.zh: : 你一点都没有反应过度。你的担心是对的。不过，要是没有猝不及防地被色情片偷袭一下，会更好。

lines.en: : Yes, I’ve been effectively convinced of that as well. I just figured it would be the easiest way to avoid the song and dance of you never admitting anything. And to that extent, it worked.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也确实被说服了。我只是觉得，这是避开你死不承认那套绕圈子的最省事的办法。就这一点而言，它奏效了。

lines.en: : You looked extremely uncomfortable last night. But it was the knowing sort of uncomfortable. Not the kind that stemmed from watching my daughter’s lookalike get fucked on TV.
lines.zh: : 你昨晚看起来极度不自在。但那是「心里有数」的那种不自在。不是看着我女儿的翻版在电视上被操的那种不自在。

lines.en: : So let’s just stop beating around the bush and face the facts. You’re attracted to teenagers. Aren’t you, Akira?
lines.zh: : 所以我们就别再拐弯抹角了，直视事实吧。你对十几岁的女孩有性趣。是吧，Akira？

lines.en: : Being attracted and actually doing something are completely-
lines.zh: : 有性趣和真的做点什么完全是——

lines.en: : Just answer the fucking question. Are you or are you not attracted to teenagers? Yes or no?
lines.zh: : 你就他妈的回答问题。你到底对不对十几岁的女孩有性趣？是还是不是？

lines.en: : I can wait here all day.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿等一整天都行。

lines.en: : ...Fine. Yes. Yes, I am.
lines.zh: : ……好。是。是，我有。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation10
: Hah...thank God. Not that you’re attracted to teenagers, obviously. Just that I can get you to be honest without a DVD player. I was actually kind of worried about that.
lines.zh: : 哈……谢天谢地。当然不是庆幸你对十几岁的女孩有性趣，而是庆幸没有 DVD 机我也能让你说实话。这一点我还真有点担心来着。

lines.en: : Maki, I’m not saying it’s fine that I feel this way or anything. But-
lines.zh: : Maki，我不是说我有这种感觉就没事了什么的。但是——

lines.en: : Akira, do you know what Sara said when I told her about what happened?
lines.zh: : Akira，你知道我把这件事告诉 Sara 的时候，她说了什么吗？

lines.en: : No, but I also didn’t even know you told her about what happened until you showed up at my door together.
lines.zh: : 不知道，而且在你们一起出现在我家门口之前，我甚至不知道你把这件事告诉了她。

lines.en: : When I told her that I thought you were into high schoolers, she said, “Well, duh. He’s a boy.”
lines.zh: : 我告诉她，我觉得你喜欢高中生，她说：「那还用说。他是个男的嘛。」

lines.en: : Well...Sara doesn’t exactly come from the most politically correct background...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sara 的成长背景算不上最政治正确……

lines.en: : When I told her that I thought you might be sleeping with Makoto, she said, “How does Makoto feel about it?”
lines.zh: : 我告诉她，我觉得你可能在和 Makoto 上床，她说：「那 Makoto 自己怎么想？」

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation11
: How does Makoto feel about it? Not, “that’s despicable” or “wow, disgusting.” Just how does she feel?
lines.zh: : 「Makoto 自己怎么想？」不是「这太卑鄙了」，也不是「哇，真恶心」。就只是问她自己怎么想？

lines.en: : Again, your frame of reference here is-
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你这里的参照系是——

lines.en: : I went to Haruka as well and her input was somehow even worse. She doesn’t have Sara’s background at all. She had the most average upbringing basically ever.
lines.zh: : 我也去找了 Haruka，她的反应不知怎么还更糟。她可完全没有 Sara 那种背景。她基本有着史上最普通的成长经历。

lines.en: : Literally no one I know is against this but me. That is weird. And what’s even weirder is that the only other person who seems to even care is the one I’m suspicious of.
lines.zh: : 我认识的人里，除了我，真的没有一个人反对这件事。这很奇怪。更奇怪的是，唯一看起来还在乎这件事的另一个人，恰恰就是我怀疑的那个。

lines.en: : How did this happen? When did everyone become so insane? When did any of this become okay?
lines.zh: : 怎么会变成这样？所有人是什么时候疯掉的？这种事又是什么时候变成「没问题」的？

lines.en: : It’s not okay, Maki.
lines.zh: : 这并不没问题，Maki。

lines.en: : Then explain it to me. Is it their looks? Their vulnerability? Do you just like that they look up to you? How did this happen?
lines.zh: : 那你给我解释解释。是因为她们的长相？她们的脆弱？还是说你就是喜欢她们仰望你的样子？这到底是怎么变成这样的？

lines.en: : It just...did. I don’t think there’s a reason for it.
lines.zh: : 就是……变成了这样。我不觉得这有什么理由。

lines.en: : At all? Not even what happened to you when you were younger? That didn’t stunt your emotional growth?
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？连你小时候经历的那些事都没有关系？那些事没有阻碍你的情感成长？

lines.en: : I mean, it almost surely did. But even if none of that stuff ever happened, we can’t guarantee I’d just only be attracted to older women. I don’t get it either. That’s just how it is.
lines.zh: : 我是说，几乎肯定有。但就算那些事一件都没发生过，我们也不能保证我就只会对比自己年长的女人有感觉。我自己也不明白。事情就是这样。

lines.en: : You kept it from me for so long, though.
lines.zh: : 可你瞒了我这么久。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, you have a teenage daughter who you’ve been openly worried about regarding sex for years now. Kind of hard to bear witness to that and then be like, “Damn, she’s hot.”
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是因为你有个十几岁的女儿，而且这些年来你一直毫不掩饰地为她在性方面的事担心。听着这些，然后来一句「靠，她真辣」，确实挺难的。

lines.en: : I tried, though. I tried telling you that night at the wall that I was way worse than you thought and you just kept telling me it wasn’t my fault. So has your mind just changed or what?
lines.zh: : 不过我试过啊。那天晚上在墙边，我试着告诉你我比你以为的糟糕得多，可你只是一直说那不是我的错。所以你是改主意了还是怎么着？

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation12
: That was before I knew what that meant! You’re my friend! Of course I wasn’t going to assume you were fucking my daughter!
lines.zh: : 那是在我知道那句话是什么意思之前！你是我的朋友！我当然不会去想你正在操我女儿！

lines.en: : Is that what Makoto told you then? That we’ve already crossed that line?
lines.zh: : 那是 Makoto 告诉你的？说我们已经越过那条线了？

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation13
: ...No. Makoto didn’t admit to anything. She was too busy reminding me that she’d be better off without me.
lines.zh: : ……没有。Makoto 什么都没承认。她光顾着提醒我，没有我她会过得更好。

lines.en: : And then Miku started going off on some ridiculous made-up tangent about a secret online boyfriend she’s been having sex with and that Makoto was just trying to cover for her.
lines.zh: : 然后 Miku 开始扯起一套荒唐的瞎编故事，说什么她有个一直在上床的神秘网友，而 Makoto 只是在替她打掩护。

lines.en: : So...not really much time to come clean about anything. But either way, I know that if I’m going to hear the truth, it’s going to have to come from you.
lines.zh: : 所以……确实没什么时间坦白什么。但不管怎样，我知道，如果我真想听到真相，那只能从你嘴里听到。

lines.en: : That’s why I asked you directly last night. And why I’ll ask you again now.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我昨晚直截了当地问了你。也是为什么我现在要再问你一次。

lines.en: : Akira, are you or are you not having sex with my daughter?
lines.zh: : Akira，你到底有没有和我女儿上床？

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation14
: Because I already know you’re the “secret online boyfriend.” And I’m hoping you have the balls to come clean about this too.
lines.zh: : 因为我已经知道你就是那个「神秘网友」了。而我希望你也有种把这件事坦白出来。

lines.en: : Please. Just put me out of my misery.
lines.zh: : 求你了。就让我脱离这苦海吧。

lines.en: : Maki, what good will getting an answer even do when you’ve already made up your mind? What will it change?
lines.zh: : Maki，既然你已经下了结论，得到一个答案又有什么用？它能改变什么？

lines.en: : Well, for one, it will show me that there’s at least one person out there who respects me.
lines.zh: : 首先，它会让我知道，这世上至少还有一个人尊重我。

lines.en: : Maybe not enough to not fuck my daughter, but enough to be honest. And enough to make me feel like I’m not throwing baseless accusations out into the ether for no reason.
lines.zh: : 也许还不足以让他不碰我女儿，但足以让他说实话。也足以让我觉得，我不是平白无故地把毫无根据的指责抛进虚空里。

lines.en: : Then if I say no, what happens?
lines.zh: : 那如果我说没有呢，会怎样？

lines.en: : I won’t believe you. I just can’t anymore. It has to be you.
lines.zh: : 我不会信你。我已经没法再信了。只能是你。

lines.en: : And if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 那如果我说有呢？

lines.en: : I do one of two things.
lines.zh: : 我会做两件事中的一件。

lines.en: : The first is that I go on a long-winded tangent about how this is the greatest betrayal I have ever faced from anyone and that I think you need to be locked away for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 第一件，是我开始长篇大论，说这是我有生以来遭遇过的最大的背叛，说我觉得你该被关起来关很久很久。

lines.en: : I tell you all about how what you’ve been through does not justify or excuse the things you do now and that, as sad as I am for you as a person, I can not and will not support you anymore.
lines.zh: : 我会一五一十地告诉你，你经历过的一切都不能为你现在所做的事开脱；还有，尽管我为你这个人感到难过，但我不能、也不会再支持你了。

lines.en: : Your face will make me sick. Every mention of you will make my heart drop. And I will never be able to trust anyone again.
lines.zh: : 你的脸会让我作呕。每一次听到有人提起你，我的心都会往下沉。而我将再也无法信任任何人。

lines.en: : I’ll be left with no one but two friends who will never understand me and two daughters who will never listen because I’m not worth listening to.
lines.zh: : 到最后，我身边只剩两个永远不会理解我的朋友，和两个永远不会听我说话的女儿——因为我不值得被倾听。

lines.en: : In several years, I’ll be forced to swallow these feelings and watch as they go off on their own to do more things that will inevitably make me sad.
lines.zh: : 几年之后，我只能把这些感情硬吞下去，看着她们各自走开，去做更多注定会让我难过的事。

lines.en: : I’ll be absolved of watching over them and spared when it comes to failing at exactly that.
lines.zh: : 我再也不用看护她们，也就免去了在这件事上失败的可能。

lines.en: : I will never forgive you. And I will ask that you stay away from both of my girls for as long as you live.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会原谅你。而我会要求你，只要你还活着，就离我的两个女儿远一点。

lines.en: : The second...
lines.zh: : 第二件事……

lines.en: : Is that I don’t do any of that. And that I sit here while my eyes swell up with tears and my jaw drops as my heart tears into a million tiny pieces.
lines.zh: : 就是我什么都不做。就这么坐在这儿，眼泪涌上来，下巴垮下去，心被撕成一百万块细小的碎片。

lines.en: : I can’t tell you which one will happen either. That’s something we’ll need to find out together.
lines.zh: : 我也说不准会发生哪一种。那是我们得一起搞清楚的事。

lines.en: : Yeah...with all due respect, I think I’d just rather have you not believe me. That sounds way easier for both of us.
lines.zh: : 嗯……恕我直言，我觉得我宁愿你别信我。那听起来对我俩都轻松多了。

lines.en: : That’s your answer then?...
lines.zh: : 那这就是你的答案了？……

lines.en: : That you just...didn’t do anything?...
lines.zh: : 也就是说你……什么都没做过？……

lines.en: : Maki, does Makoto know you’re here right now?
lines.zh: : Maki，Makoto 知道你现在在这儿吗？

lines.en: : Are you serious? You saw how she acted last night. She’d kill me if she knew I was here.
lines.zh: : 你认真的？你看见她昨晚那副样子了。她要是知道我在这儿，会杀了我的。

lines.en: : Well, unfortunately, I think you came here for nothing. You’re not going to get an answer out of me. You can get one from her if you really need it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很遗憾，我觉得你这趟是白来了。你从我这儿得不到答案。如果你真需要，可以去问她。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation15
: Seriously, Akira?...
lines.zh: : 你认真的吗，Akira？……

lines.en: : You don’t even have the balls to give it to me straight?...
lines.zh: : 你连直截了当告诉我的胆子都没有？……

lines.en: : I really don’t, actually. I’m kind of pathetic, if you haven’t noticed.
lines.zh: : 我真的没有，说实话。我挺没用的，你可能也看出来了。

lines.en: : Forcefully extracting information from me doesn’t work as well as just waiting for me to have an emotional breakdown so I can reveal it on my own. Maybe don’t stop me next time?
lines.zh: : 硬从我这儿挖话，不如就等我自己情绪崩溃、自己把话说出来来得有效。也许下次你别拦着我？

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation16
: Please don’t hurt her...
lines.zh: : 求你别伤害她……

lines.en: : This is my daughter, Akira. She deserves at least one adult to look up to.
lines.zh: : 她是我女儿，Akira。她至少该有一个能仰望的成年人。

lines.en: : Maki, I don’t want to hurt her. Makoto means way more to me than you can probably even comprehend. And if you want to earn her respect, you can’t just go around her like this.
lines.zh: : Maki，我不想伤害她。Makoto 对我的意义，大概远超你的想象。而如果你想赢得她的尊重，就不能像这样绕过她。

lines.en: : Do you remember what we talked about the last time we sat here together?...
lines.zh: : 你还记得上次我们坐在这儿时聊了什么吗？……

lines.en: : Your...husband?
lines.zh: : 你的……丈夫？

lines.en: : That’s right...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: : And how I needed to step up to make up for him not being around anymore...
lines.zh: : 还有我得顶上来，弥补他不在了的空缺……

lines.en: : So how did you come out on top?
lines.zh: : 那你是怎么占了上风的？

lines.en: : Why are you the one she looks up to when you don’t even try?...
lines.zh: : 你连试都没试过，为什么她仰望的人反而是你？……

lines.en: : You’re even weaker than me...I don’t understand it.
lines.zh: : 你比我还软弱……我不明白。

lines.en: : I don’t either, Maki. And I know my word doesn’t mean much, if anything, to you at this point, but I am not trying to fill your role. I am not trying to be a parent to her.
lines.zh: : 我也不明白，Maki。我知道到了这个地步，我的话对你来说没什么分量——如果还有的话——但我不是在试图取代你的位置。我不是想当她的家长。

lines.en: : Oh, great. Just a lover then. That’s so much better. Thank you, Akira. I’ll go home now. Sorry for bothering you.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。那就是个情人喽。这可好多了。谢谢你，Akira。我这就回家。抱歉打扰了。

lines.en: : Hah...I kind of wish you’d just freak out on me. It looked like you were about to for a second.
lines.zh: : 哈……我倒有点希望你就这么冲我发火。刚才有一瞬间你看起来快爆发了。

lines.en: : I’ve been driven to my knees in the worst way possible. I am desperate and scared and alone and no one will listen to me.
lines.zh: : 我已经被用最糟糕的方式逼得跪下了。我绝望、害怕、孤身一人，没有一个人愿意听我说话。

lines.en: : You’d also have trouble acting in my position. Everything I can do is wrong. There’s no way out.
lines.zh: : 你处在我的位置，也一样会不知所措。我能做的每一件事都是错的。没有出路。

lines.en: : There rarely is. It’s all just forward or backwards or around in circles like the ants that we are. Then we die and start over or whatever it is that happens.
lines.zh: : 出路本来就少有。一切都不过是向前、向后，或者像我们这样的蚂蚁一样原地打转。然后我们死掉、重新开始，或者发生别的什么。

lines.en: : Thanks. That helps too. You’re really good at this.
lines.zh: : 谢了。这也挺有帮助的。你真的很擅长这个。

lines.en: : No one is going to hurt your daughter, Maki. She’s one of the strongest girls I’ve ever met. And I’m one of the weakest men, so I probably couldn’t even if I tried.
lines.zh: : 没有人会伤害你女儿的，Maki。她是我见过的最坚强的女孩之一。而我是最软弱的男人之一，所以就算我想，大概也伤不了她。

lines.en: : She might be strong and you might be weak, but I still don’t think you understand the influence you have over these girls, Akira.
lines.zh: : 她也许坚强，你也许软弱，但我还是觉得你不明白你对这些女孩有多大的影响力，Akira。

lines.en: : These are the most important years of their lives. Everything you do is going to impact them in ways you can’t even imagine. And I don’t want them ending up on a screen one day.
lines.zh: : 这是她们一生中最重要的几年。你做的每一件事都会以你无法想象的方式影响她们。而我不希望她们有一天出现在某块屏幕上。

lines.en: : So please...stay away from them. There are plenty of other girls out there who aren’t on the verge of being permanently damaged by one wrong move.
lines.zh: : 所以求你了……离她们远一点。外面有的是别的女孩，她们不会因为你走错一步就被永久地毁掉。

lines.en: : And if they come to me? Should I just ignore them?
lines.zh: : 那如果她们主动来找我呢？我就该无视她们吗？

lines.en: : If you can’t keep your hands to yourself, yes. Why is this so hard to understand?
lines.zh: : 如果你管不住自己的手，那就该。这有什么难理解的？

lines.en: : Because I’m an idiot.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个白痴。

lines.en: : We’re both idiots — fumbling our way through parenthood with daughters who won’t ever do what we want them to. But at least yours isn’t a fucking psychopath.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都是白痴——都在为人父母这件事上笨手笨脚，女儿又永远不肯按我们的意思来。不过至少你那个不是个该死的精神变态。

lines.en: : No...just really mean.
lines.zh: : 不是……只是特别刻薄。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation17
: Really mean...
lines.zh: : 特别刻薄……

lines.en: : I’ve cried more in the last twenty four hours than I did after Masahiro died...
lines.zh: : 过去二十四小时里我流的泪，比 Masahiro 死后流的还多……

lines.en: : I’m at my breaking point, Akira. That’s why all I wanted was a little grace with you. That you’d come clean and just...stop this.
lines.zh: : 我到极限了，Akira。所以我只想要你给我一点体面——你坦白，然后……把这事停了。

lines.en: scene makiconfrontation18
: But it seems like you won’t...and now I have to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 但看起来你不会……那我现在就不得不去面对这件事了。

lines.en: : Well...how will you?
lines.zh: : 那……你打算怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : But I’d appreciate it if you’d stay away from my store, my daughter, and me until I can figure that out.
lines.zh: : 不过在我搞清楚之前，希望你别来我的店，别碰我女儿，也别来找我。

lines.en: : I really hope you get the help you need.
lines.zh: : 我真心希望你能得到你需要的帮助。

lines.en: : Goodbye, Akira.
lines.zh: : 再见，Akira。

lines.en: scene black
: Sniff...Sara? Come on. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : （抽鼻子）……Sara？走了。我们回去吧。

lines.en: : One second! Ami’s almost done with-
lines.zh: : 等一下！Ami 差不多就快——

lines.en: : Sara! Let’s go!
lines.zh: : Sara！走了！

lines.en: : Maki, I’m really sorry. But Makoto will be way better at talking to you about-
lines.zh: : Maki，我真的很抱歉。不过 Makoto 会比我们更擅长跟你谈——

lines.en: : Please, just leave me the fuck alone. Sara!
lines.zh: : 求你了，就他妈的别管我。Sara！

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’m here. Let’s go. Bye, Sensei. Tell Ami she looks cute today! I helped her with her makeup.
lines.zh: : 好啦好啦。我在这儿呢。走吧。再见，Sensei。跟 Ami 说她今天很可爱！她的妆是我帮她化的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I will.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我会的。

lines.en: : Bye, guys. Be...safe and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 再见，各位。那个……注意安全之类的。

lines.en: : Yeah...be safe.
lines.zh: : 嗯……注意安全。

lines.en: Maki leaves. Sara leaves. Then later, Ami leaves. And I’m left alone with my thoughts.
lines.zh: Maki 走了。Sara 走了。再后来，Ami 也走了。只剩下我和自己的思绪。

lines.en: But instead of dwelling on them or hating myself for the situation I put a good friend of mine in, I do the exact opposite of what I’m supposed to.
lines.zh: 但我没有沉溺其中，也没有为把一个好朋友置于这种境地而自责——我做了与我该做的完全相反的事。

lines.en: I tap on a name in my phone and wait for someone to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开一个名字，等有人接起来。

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei. I was actually meaning to call. Last night-
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei。我其实正想打电话给你。昨晚——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Are you free right now? Ami just left.
lines.zh: : 那个不用管。你现在有空吗？Ami 刚走。

lines.en: : Just left...your house? Are you-
lines.zh: : 刚离开……你家？你是——

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我是。

lines.en: : I’ll be right over.
lines.zh: : 我马上过来。

The rest of the day is a blur as I get lost somewhere I’m not supposed to be.
lines.zh: 那天剩下的时间模糊成一片，我迷失在一个我不该在的地方。

lines.en: There’s something that feels like remorse, but there’s someone to take those feelings away.
lines.zh: 有一种感觉像是懊悔，但有人会把那些感觉带走。

lines.en: Someone I will not be kept from.
lines.zh: 一个我绝不会被拦着见不到的人。

lines.en: Someone you can not hide from me.
lines.zh: 一个你无法从我面前藏起来的人。

lines.en: Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
lines.zh: Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]!

lines.en: Makoto’s lust has increased to [makoto_lust]!
lines.zh: Makoto 的欲望提升到了 [makoto_lust]!

lines.en: Maki is gone.
lines.zh: Maki 走了。
